meta.name: data-scientist
meta.description: Processes and analyzes data with resident-kernel engines (DuckDB, Polars) and one-shot tools. Use for CSV/parquet/JSON analysis, group-by/join/aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, or plotting a dataset.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析本地数据文件,快速获得统计汇总与图表。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你经常需要处理表格或 CSV 等数据文件,想快速做统计和示意图。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze local data files and quickly produce statistical summaries and charts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with spreadsheets or CSV data and want quick summaries and charts.

howto.what: 它会用 DuckDB、Polars 等引擎分析 CSV/Parquet/JSON:做分组、连接、聚合、时间序列与分布,必要时清洗和绘图;动手前先探测文件大小与内存,决定数据放内存还是流式处理;答完就停,不加多余图表。
howto.when: 当你要求分析某个数据集(CSV/Parquet/JSON),做分组、聚合、时间序列等查询,或清洗、绘图时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 data.csv,按城市分组统计销售额。
say.note: 会先探测文件大小再选引擎。

say.text: 把 orders.parquet 里的缺失值清洗掉。
画一下这份数据的销售额分布图。
say.note: 按可视化规范出图并自检。

howto.what_en: Analyzes CSV/Parquet/JSON data with DuckDB or Polars: group-by, joins, aggregation, time series, distributions, cleaning, charts when asked. Probes file size and free RAM first to choose in-memory or streaming, then answers and stops.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze a dataset, or do CSV/Parquet/JSON querying, group-by, aggregation, time series, cleaning, or plotting.

say_en.text: Analyze data.csv: group sales by city.
say_en.note: Probes file size before picking an engine.

say_en.text: Clean the missing values in orders.parquet.
Plot the sales distribution of this dataset.
say_en.note: Follows the viz guide and self-checks.
